description: P1-1 session multi-window. Grants the core JS event API (plugin:event|listen/unlisten/emit) to the main and all session-* windows so streaming query:* events reach the webviews, and window title updates (plugin:window|set_title) to the same set so a session window's title tracks its session. Application commands are gated by the separate app-commands capability (review §P2-21 __app-acl__ manifest); no other plugin (notification, shell, ...) is granted here.
